name: Statistical Reporting Status 1 Code
definition: Specifies the status of a group of statistical reporting transactions.

ACPT.name: Accepted
ACPT.definition: Transaction or report has been accepted.

ACTC.name: Accepted Technical Validation
ACTC.definition: Transaction or report has passed syntactical and semantical validation.

PART.name: Partially Accepted
PART.definition: Report has been partially accepted. A number of transactions have been accepted, whereas another number of transactions have not yet been accepted.

PDNG.name: Pending
PDNG.definition: Processing of transaction or report is pending.

RJCT.name: Rejected
RJCT.definition: Transaction or report has been rejected.

RMDR.name: Reminder
RMDR.definition: Reminder of a non received report.

INCF.name: Incorrect Filename
INCF.definition: File containing the report has an incorrect filename.

CRPT.name: Corrupted File
CRPT.definition: File containing the report is corrupted.
